Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Experience with application monitoring and log analysis. Basic understanding of APIs and production support processes.  Good to Have Exposure to ORMS or Order Management Systems. Knowledge of MongoDB. Familiarity with financial markets or trading platforms. Basic Linux commands. Experience with Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, or similar monitoring tools. Basic scripting or automation knowledge.

title: Senior Merchandiser HBC (Health, Beauty & Cosmetics)
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced merchandising professional with strong technical expertise in the Health, Beauty & Cosmetics (HBC) category to lead sourcing, product development, supplier management, and commercial execution for international retail customers. The candidate should possess in-depth knowledge of cosmetics, personal care, beauty accessories, regulatory compliance, formulation concepts, packaging development. The role requires a commercially driven professional who can identify market opportunities, develop profitable product assortments, and build strong supplier partnerships to support business growth. 
 Key Skills Develop and execute sourcing strategies for Health, Beauty & Cosmetics categories, including: Skin Care Hair Care Bath & Body Oral Care Men's Grooming Cosmetics & Color Cosmetics Beauty Tools & Accessories Wellness & Personal Care Fragrance OTC Personal Care Build commercially competitive product assortments aligned with customer requirements and market trends. Identify category growth opportunities through trend analysis, benchmarking, and consumer insights. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop and execute merchandising strategies for the Health, Beauty & Cosmetics category (US market). Source innovative HBC products aligned with customer requirements and market trends. Develop new suppliers and manufacturers across beauty, cosmetics, skincare, personal care, wellness, and OTC categories. Identify new product opportunities through market research and trend analysis. Coordinate product development from concept to commercialization. Evaluate packaging options, formulations, fragrances, and product positioning. Lead product development from concept to commercialization. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements with suppliers. Ensure competitive costing while maintaining quality, compliance, and delivery standards. Possess strong understanding of cosmetic regulations across global markets, including US FDA. Monitor global market trends, emerging ingredients, packaging technologies, and sustainability initiatives within the HBC industry. Negotiate pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and production timelines. Ensure suppliers meet customer quality and ethical compliance requirements. Experience in retail or pharmaceutical companies is a plus. FDA experience 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Business, Commerce, or a related field. MBA in Marketing, International Business, Supply Chain, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 Experience 1012 years of merchandising, sourcing, or product development experience. Minimum 7–9 years of experience in the Health, Beauty & Cosmetics category. Strong experience working with buying houses, international retailers, sourcing offices, importers, exporters, or cosmetic manufacturers.

Key Skills: Beauty,Health,HBC,Cosmetics,Merchandising,Personal Care,Home Care,Wellness

description:
Position 
IT Manager Department Information Technology Industry BPO / ITES Team Size 20 IT Staff 
Role Summary
 We are seeking a seasoned IT Manager with deep hands-on experience in BPO infrastructure, network security, and dialer operations. The ideal candidate will be a technical leader who can simultaneously manage enterprise infrastructure, enforce security policies, and keep mission-critical call-center operations running 24/7. This role demands equal parts technical depth and operational discipline. 
Key Responsibilities
 1. Infrastructure & Network Management 
 Design, deploy, and maintain scalable LAN/WAN/VPN infrastructure for BPO floor operations
 Manage Sophos XG/XGS & Meraki Firewall policy creation, IPS/IDS rules, SSL inspection, and threat intelligence feeds
 Administer SD-WAN, MPLS, and ISP link aggregation/failover for zero-downtime operations
 Oversee VLAN segmentation across agent floors, management zones, PCI/compliance environments, and DMZ
 Monitor bandwidth, QoS prioritization for SIP traffic, and application-level controls
 Manage structured cabling, patch panels, PoE switches, and data center rack organization
 
 2. Dialer & Telephony Operations 
 Administer predictive/progressive/preview dialers Avaya, Genesys, Vicidial, Five9, or equivalent
 Configure SIP trunks, DID routing, IVR call flows, and agent skill-based routing
 Manage dialer campaign setup, disposition mapping, TCPA/DNC list compliance, and call recording
 Monitor real-time dialer performance: abandon rates, pacing ratios, concurrent calls, and agent utilization
 Troubleshoot call quality issues jitter, packet loss, echo, latency using tools like Wireshark/SolarWinds
 Coordinate with telecom carriers for SLA enforcement, number porting, and capacity augmentation
 Ensure business continuity with dialer failover configurations and backup SIP carrier routing
 
 3. Linux Systems Administration 
 Administer CentOS, RHEL, Ubuntu, and Debian servers in production BPO environments
 Manage system performance: CPU/memory tuning, disk I/O optimization, kernel parameters, and swap
 Automate routine tasks via Bash scripting, Cron jobs, and Python automation scripts
 Deploy and manage services: Apache/Nginx, MySQL/MariaDB, SSH hardening, NFS/Samba, and FTP
 Implement Linux-based security: SELinux/AppArmor policies, auditd, fail2ban, and IPTables/nftables
 Manage centralized log aggregation with rsyslog/syslog-ng and ELK Stack or Graylog
 Perform capacity planning, performance benchmarking, and root cause analysis for Linux incidents
 
 4. Security & Compliance 
 Own and enforce IT security policies aligned with ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or NASSCOM guidelines

 Administer identity and access management: Active Directory, LDAP, MFA, and PAM solutions
 Implement and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for agent workstations and email gateways
 Lead security awareness training and quarterly phishing simulation exercises for BPO staff
 Maintain audit-ready documentation: change logs, access reviews, incident reports, and VAPT records

 Lead and mentor a team of IT support engineers, NOC analysts, and helpdesk technicians

 Manage ITSM workflows using Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or ServiceNow

 Manage vendor relationships: ISPs, hardware OEMs, software licensors, and managed service providers
 Prepare monthly IT MIS reports, capacity dashboards, and security posture summaries for leadership

 Administer hybrid cloud environments: AWS, Azure, or GCP for backup, DR, and SaaS integration

description:
Job Description Summary The Project Engineering Director HVDC serves as the primary technical authority and engineering lead for large-scale HVDC projects. You will be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of HVDC systems, ensuring that engineering, design, testing, and commissioning activities are executed to the highest standards of safety, quality, and technical integrity.
You will manage a multidisciplinary engineering team and interface with internal manufacturing, sourcing, and project management teams, as well as external consortium partners and utility customers. This role is pivotal in ensuring that complex, multi-year energy transition projects meet all grid code requirements and performance specifications within budget and schedule. Job Description Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Project Leadership Lead the total engineering scope for HVDC projects, from contract inception through to final commissioning and site acceptance tests (SAT). Define the technical execution strategy, including design lifecycle, design reviews, and engineering document management. Act as the primary technical interface for the customer, acting as the bridge between internal engineering teams and customer technical stakeholders. Ensure technical alignment with consortium partners, subcontractors, and suppliers. 2. Engineering Governance and Quality Oversee the implementation of robust engineering processes, design verification, and validation (VV) procedures. Ensure all technical documentation meets company standards, international codes (IEC, IEEE), and grid code compliance. Lead formal design review processes (PDR, CDR) to ensure technical risk is identified and mitigated early. Manage engineering changes, deviations, and non-conformances with a focus on impact analysis and rigorous documentation. 3. Cross-Functional Integration Manage the interface between primary equipment, secondary systems, control, and protection, and HVDC valve/converter technology. Coordinate with Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to ensure technical specifications are met and supply chain risks are managed through engineering solutions. Drive the integration of digital tools and BIM/PLM processes to optimize engineering efficiency. Work closely with the Project Director to ensure engineering milestones support the overall project schedule and cash flow. 4. Technical Risk and Issue Management Proactively identify technical bottlenecks and system integration risks. Develop and lead recovery plans for technical challenges arising during engineering or commissioning. Provide expert-level judgment on technical trade-offs, balancing system performance, cost, and schedule. Ensure "Lessons Learned" are captured from previous projects and integrated into current design processes. 5. Talent and Resource Management Lead and mentor a large, geographically dispersed team of systems, design, and commissioning engineers. Set technical direction, define competencies, and ensure the right technical talent is assigned to project tasks. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement within the engineering organization. Support organizational development by identifying training and certification needs for the engineering staff. Required Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems focus preferred). 15+ years of professional experience in large-scale power system engineering, specifically in HVDC technology, FACTS, or high-voltage substations . Proven experience in leading major engineering projects, managing multi-disciplinary technical teams, and interfacing with high-profile utility/TSO customers. Preferred Qualifications Expert knowledge of HVDC converter stations , control systems, and power electronics. Experience with EPC delivery models and multi-party consortium agreements. Experience in requirement gathering and preparing functional specifications. Good knowledge of testing, UAT, issue tracking, and change management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand business processes and recommend practical ERP solutions. title: Problem Manager- IMS and CS Core
description:
About This Opportunity We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.   What You Will Do 

  Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
  Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
  Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
  Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
  Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
  Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
  Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
  Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
  Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
  Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
  Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
  Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
  Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation 
  Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
  Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
  Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
  Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs   What You Will Bring 

  Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
  Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
  Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
  Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
  Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes   Experience & Qualifications 
 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
  Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent 
 Preferred Qualifications 
  ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
  Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
  Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM

title: MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Key Responsibilities A. MRO Facility Setup Lead the establishment of the MRO facility from concept to operational readiness. Responsibilities include: Develop the MRO business plan. Define MRO service scope. Identify required infrastructure. Prepare facility-layout requirements. Define workstations and maintenance bays. Identify tooling and test equipment. Define ESD-safe work areas where required. Establish battery handling/storage areas. Develop component-storage facilities. Establish quarantine and rejected-parts areas. Develop final inspection and testing areas. Establish documentation and records systems. Prepare the initial MRO equipment and infrastructure requirement list . 4. Drone Maintenance Develop preventive and scheduled maintenance programmes for UAV platforms. Maintenance activities may include: Airframe inspection Motor inspection Propeller inspection ESC inspection Flight-controller inspection GPS/navigation-system inspection Communication-system inspection Battery inspection Payload inspection Wiring inspection Connector inspection Firmware/software checks Sensor checks Structural inspection Fastener checks Calibration checks Pre-flight/post-flight inspection Develop maintenance schedules based on: Flight hours Flight cycles Calendar time Manufacturer recommendations Operating environment Mission profile Component condition 5. Repair & Troubleshooting Establish systematic fault-diagnosis and repair procedures. The MRO team should be capable of diagnosing: Electrical faults Electronic faults Communication failures Flight-controller faults GPS/navigation problems Motor/ESC failures Power-system failures Battery-related issues Sensor failures Payload faults Wiring/connectivity problems Software/firmware issues Structural damage Develop standard troubleshooting procedures and diagnostic checklists. 6. Overhaul & Refurbishment Develop capabilities for overhaul and refurbishment of eligible drone systems and components. Activities may include: Complete system inspection Disassembly Component-level inspection Replacement of worn/damaged components Reassembly Calibration Functional testing Ground testing Flight testing where authorised and appropriate Final inspection Return-to-service documentation Maintain complete traceability of replaced components and maintenance activities. 7. Fleet Maintenance Develop fleet-maintenance programmes for institutional and commercial customers. Potential customers may include: Drone operators Survey companies Agriculture companies Infrastructure companies Mining companies Power companies Government agencies PSUs Industrial organisations Logistics companies Drone service providers Develop customer-specific: Maintenance schedules AMC packages Service-level agreements Spare-parts programmes Inspection schedules Fleet-health reports 8. Warranty & After-Sales Support Coordinate closely with the manufacturing and customer-support teams for: Warranty claims Technical complaints Field failures Product recalls, where applicable Component replacement Repair turnaround Customer communication Root-cause analysis Develop a structured Failure Reporting, Analysis and Corrective Action System . 9. MRO Quality System Establish a robust quality-management system for all MRO activities. Develop: SOPs Maintenance manuals Inspection checklists Repair procedures Quality inspection procedures Calibration procedures Tool-control procedures Component traceability Non-conformance procedures Corrective-action procedures Final inspection procedures Release documentation All maintenance activities must be performed within the applicable regulatory, manufacturer and organisational requirements. 10. Regulatory & Compliance Maintain awareness of applicable Indian aviation/drone regulations and ensure that MRO activities are undertaken only within the organisation's permitted scope. The MRO Head will coordinate with the company's regulatory/compliance function regarding applicable requirements of: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) Ministry of Civil Aviation Applicable Drone Rules/regulations Applicable UAS-related requirements Manufacturer maintenance instructions Applicable safety requirements Environmental and workplace-safety requirements Where a particular maintenance, component or aircraft category requires a specific approval, authorisation, certification or licensed personnel, the MRO Head must ensure that the work is performed only by appropriately authorised personnel. 11. Spare Parts Management Establish a dedicated MRO spare-parts system. Manage: Critical spares Fast-moving components Consumables Repairable components Rotable components Batteries Motors ESCs Flight controllers GPS modules Sensors Propellers Connectors Wiring Electronic components Structural parts Develop: Minimum/maximum stock levels Reorder levels Supplier database Approved vendor list Part-number system Serial-number tracking Shelf-life tracking Component traceability 12. Tools & Test Equipment Identify and maintain appropriate: Electrical test equipment Multimeters Power analysers Battery analysers Soldering/rework equipment Electronic diagnostic equipment Motor/ESC testing equipment Calibration equipment Communication-test equipment Ground-test equipment Software diagnostic tools Drone-specific service tools Ensure appropriate calibration and tool-control records are maintained. 13. Battery Maintenance & Safety Develop specific procedures for UAV battery management, including: Inspection Charging Storage Health monitoring Capacity testing Cycle tracking Damage assessment Isolation of damaged batteries Disposal/recycling coordination Battery safety should be treated as a critical MRO function, particularly for lithium-based systems. 14. Technical Documentation Establish a comprehensive documentation system covering: Aircraft/drone history Serial numbers Flight hours/cycles Maintenance history Repairs Component replacements Battery history Inspection records Test results Calibration records Warranty claims Defects Accident/damage reports Return-to-service records Develop a digital Drone Maintenance Management System as the operation scales. 15. Root Cause & Reliability Engineering Analyse recurring failures and identify improvement opportunities. Develop: Failure database Failure-rate analysis Root-cause analysis Reliability reports Corrective-action plans Preventive-action plans Work with the R&D and manufacturing teams to feed MRO findings back into product design. 
 16. MRO Business Development Work with the Business Development team to develop the commercial MRO business. Develop services such as: Annual Maintenance Contracts Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts Pay-per-service maintenance Fleet maintenance Component repair Battery-health services Inspection packages Refurbishment Emergency repair Field-support contracts Technical support packages OEM-authorised service, where applicable Identify third-party drone fleets that may require maintenance support. 17. MRO Pricing & Commercial Management Develop commercially viable pricing models for: Preventive maintenance Corrective maintenance Inspection Repair Overhaul Component replacement Labour Field service AMC CMC Emergency support Track: Cost per repair Labour hours Spare-parts consumption Turnaround time Gross margin Warranty cost Customer profitability 18. MRO Turnaround Time Establish measurable service levels. Indicative metrics may include: Initial inspection time Diagnosis time Repair turnaround time Spare-part availability Final testing time Customer delivery time 19. Develop a system for tracking: Aircraft Received Inspection Diagnosis Estimate Approval Repair Testing Quality Inspection Release Customer 
 20. Coordination with Manufacturing & R&D The MRO Manager will work closely with: Manufacturing Product reliability Assembly issues Component failures Production quality R&D Design improvements Failure analysis New component testing Product modifications Quality Non-conformances Inspection systems Corrective actions Procurement Spare parts Vendors Component availability Business Development AMC/CMC Customer requirements MRO contracts This integration will help establish a complete Drone Product Lifecycle Management System .

The successful candidate should be comfortable developing systems where they do not yet exist, including: SOPs Workflows MRO software Spare-parts systems Technician training Vendor network Customer service processes Quality systems Pricing models AMC/CMC packages The candidate will be expected to move between strategy and hands-on execution during the initial establishment phase. 27. title: Government R&D and Innovation Funding Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities The primary objective of this position is to build and manage a Government Funding Pipeline for the Drone Manufacturing Hub and its participating projects. The incumbent will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop proposals for: Research & Development Advanced drone technologies Indigenous drone components Prototyping and product development Testing and certification infrastructure Manufacturing infrastructure Technology commercialisation Defence and dual-use technologies Artificial intelligence and autonomous systems Robotics and swarm technologies Agriculture and precision applications Mapping, surveying and geospatial applications Communication, navigation and sensing technologies Battery, propulsion and power systems Electronics, avionics and flight-control systems Technology transfer and industry-academia collaboration Start-up and MSME innovation programmes Key Responsibilities 1. Government Funding Identification Continuously identify and track relevant Government of India funding schemes, calls for proposals, grants, soft loans, equity/innovation support, challenge programmes and other eligible financial instruments. The role will monitor programmes and institutions including, as applicable: Department of Science & Technology (DST) Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund Technology Development Board (TDB) Ministry of Defence / Department of Defence Production iDEX Innovations for Defence Excellence Technology Development Fund (TDF) Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), where relevant to biotechnology/agri-biotech drone applications Ministry of Civil Aviation Other Central Government Ministries and Departments State Government innovation and industrial-development programmes Government-supported incubators and technology missions Relevant public-sector and development-finance institutions The employee shall verify the current eligibility, funding structure, application window, eligible expenditure, matching contribution requirements, intellectual-property provisions and milestone requirements of each scheme before recommending it. 2. RDI Fund / ANRF Funding Develop a specialised funding pipeline under the Government's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) framework , including opportunities routed through authorised Second-Level Fund Managers. The position shall: Track RDI funding calls relevant to drones, advanced manufacturing, electronics, AI, robotics and strategic technologies. Identify eligible private-sector, start-up and industry-led projects. Coordinate preparation of technical and financial proposals. Develop project-level funding requirements and milestone plans. Coordinate with authorised Fund Managers and implementing agencies. Maintain documentation required for due diligence and appraisal. Track sanctioned projects, disbursements and utilisation. Ensure that proposals are aligned with the applicable RDI guidelines and financial rules. The RDI Scheme is particularly relevant because the Government has structured it to catalyse private-sector investment in R&D and innovation, with the framework operationalised through ANRF and designated fund managers. R RDI Fund+1 3. Defence Innovation Funding Identify appropriate opportunities under iDEX, TDF and other Ministry of Defence innovation programmes for eligible drone and dual-use technologies. Responsibilities include: Monitoring iDEX challenges and defence problem statements. Identifying technologies suitable for defence applications. Coordinating with start-ups, MSMEs, academia and technology developers. Preparing technical-commercial proposals. Developing milestone-based budgets. Coordinating prototype-development funding. Supporting access to testing facilities and defence users where applicable. Tracking procurement/commercialisation opportunities following successful technology development. iDEX provides funding support for eligible innovation proposals and encourages expenditure on R&D, prototyping, pilot implementation and market assessment. TDF is another relevant channel for indigenous defence technology development, including industry-academia/research-institution collaboration. 4. Government Grant Proposal Development Lead preparation of high-quality funding proposals covering: Executive summary Problem statement Technology description Innovation and technology-readiness level R&D methodology Work packages Project milestones Project implementation schedule Human-resource requirements Capital expenditure R&D expenditure Prototype-development costs Testing and certification costs Manufacturing scale-up requirements Domestic value addition Commercialisation strategy Intellectual-property strategy Market opportunity Employment-generation potential Export potential Strategic relevance Risk analysis Financial projections Funding requirement Co-funding/matching contribution, wherever applicable Expected measurable outcomes 5. Funding Strategy for the Drone Manufacturing Hub Develop a 5 year Government Funding Roadmap for the Hub. The roadmap should identify separate funding requirements for: R&D laboratories Prototype-development facilities Drone testing infrastructure Electronics and avionics development AI/autonomy laboratories Battery and propulsion R&D Manufacturing facilities Common facility centres Certification and compliance infrastructure Start-up incubation Industry-academia collaborative projects Technology commercialisation Defence/dual-use applications Export-oriented manufacturing The manager will create a Scheme-to-Project Matrix showing which Government programme may potentially support each project, subject to the applicable eligibility conditions. 6. Government Liaison and Stakeholder Management Develop and maintain professional relationships with: Central Government Ministries Government departments ANRF DST TDB DRDO/defence innovation ecosystem iDEX/DIO State Government departments Government-supported incubators Universities and IITs/NITs Research institutions Industry associations Start-ups and MSMEs Technology partners Financial institutions Potential co-funding partners All engagement shall be conducted through proper institutional channels and in accordance with applicable Government procedures and organisational policies. 7. IndustryAcademiaGovernment Projects Build consortiums involving: Industry + Start-up/MSME + University/R&D Institution + Government/End User for eligible R&D and innovation programmes. The candidate shall identify complementary capabilities and prepare consortium proposals with clearly defined: Technical responsibilities Financial responsibilities Intellectual-property ownership Technology-transfer arrangements Milestones Deliverables Commercialisation rights Compliance obligations 8. Monitoring and Compliance Maintain a comprehensive database of: Funding schemes Funding calls Application deadlines Eligibility criteria Submitted proposals Sanctioned projects Funding amount Disbursement milestones Utilisation certificates Project milestones Government correspondence Audit requirements Reporting requirements Ensure that no funding claim, eligibility statement or proposal is submitted without verification against the latest applicable Government notification/guidelines. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 The candidate will be evaluated on measurable outcomes such as: Government funding opportunities identified and qualified Number of eligible proposals developed Value of proposals submitted Value of funding sanctioned Number of Government/industry/R&D partnerships established Number of successful R&D projects Number of technologies progressed from prototype to commercialisation Number of start-ups/MSMEs supported Number of industry-academia projects established Funding pipeline value Proposal success/conversion rate Timely submission of applications and reports Compliance with Government funding conditions Important: KPIs shall measure professional activity and actual sanctioned funding, not guarantee that any Government authority will approve a proposal. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Management, Finance, Economics or a related discipline. Master's degree/MBA/M.Tech/PhD or equivalent qualification will be an advantage. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in government funding, R&D grants, technology programmes, business development, project finance, innovation management or institutional fundraising. Experience with Government of India schemes will be strongly preferred. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following: Government R&D grants DST/ANRF programmes TDB programmes Defence innovation programmes iDEX TDF/DRDO ecosystem MSME/start-up funding Technology commercialisation Industry-academia projects Drone/UAV/UAS technology Aerospace Defence technology Electronics AI/robotics Advanced manufacturing Semiconductor/electronics ecosystem Battery/energy technology Essential Skills Government proposal writing Grant writing Project finance Government scheme interpretation Budget preparation Technical proposal development Financial modelling Business-plan preparation Project management Stakeholder management Government correspondence Research and analytical skills Excellent written and verbal communication Presentation skills MS Office/Google Workspace Ability to prepare detailed project reports (DPRs) Desirable Skills Knowledge of: Drone Rules and applicable UAS regulatory framework Drone certification and testing ecosystem Make in India / Atmanirbhar Bharat programmes Government procurement Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) Intellectual-property management Technology transfer Manufacturing value-chain development Defence procurement ecosystem Startup and MSME ecosystem CSR/ESG funding, where legally and operationally applicable Professional Competencies The ideal candidate should demonstrate: Strong Government funding network knowledge High-quality proposal-writing capability Ability to understand complex technical projects Strong financial and commercial understanding Ability to convert technical concepts into fundable projects Strong follow-up and documentation discipline High integrity and compliance orientation Ability to work with senior Government, academic and industry stakeholders Ability to manage multiple funding applications simultaneously 
 Perks and benefits A performance-linked component may be considered based on measurable responsibilities such as proposal development, project mobilisation, partnerships and successful institutional funding outcomes, subject to applicable employment and organisational policies.

title: Video Editor - English - News
description:
Role: Video Editor - News - English 
 Experience: 2 - 5 Years
 Location: Noida, Sector 62
 Industry: Digital Media / News 
 Work: 6 Days working - WFO - Rotational Shift 
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a skilled Video Editor to create engaging and visually appealing video content for our English News platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in editing news videos, short-form digital content, and social media videos with a strong understanding of storytelling and current digital video trends. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Edit English news videos for digital platforms, YouTube, social media, and other content channels. Work closely with the editorial team to understand the story, script, and visual requirements. Select and edit relevant footage, interviews, images, graphics, and other visual elements. Create engaging short-form and long-form news videos with appropriate pacing and storytelling. Add titles, lower thirds, captions, transitions, graphics, music, and other elements as required. Ensure videos are accurate, visually appealing, and aligned with editorial standards. Handle multiple stories and deliver videos within tight deadlines, especially during breaking news and high-priority news cycles. Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for social media and digital platforms. Stay updated with current video formats, audience trends, and digital storytelling practices. 
 Requirements: 
 2-5 years of experience in video editing , preferably in digital news, media, publishing, or a similar environment. Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro ; knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop is an advantage. Good understanding of news video editing and digital storytelling . Strong sense of timing, pacing, visual composition, and storytelling. Ability to work with footage from multiple sources and create coherent news stories. Good command of English and an understanding of English news content. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight publishing deadlines. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy in news-related content. Willingness to work in shifts, including during major news events when required. Good to Have Experience working with a digital news organisation or newsroom . Experience creating videos for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and other social platforms . Basic knowledge of motion graphics and animation. Experience editing breaking news, interviews, explainers, or trending news content. Understanding of platform-specific video formats and audience engagement.

title: Air Ticketing Executive
description:
About the Role: As an Air Ticketing Executive at EaseMyTrip.com , you will be responsible for managing flight bookings, modifications, cancellations, and customer queries related to air travel. You will interact directly with customers, travel agents, and airline partners to ensure accurate and timely ticket issuance and support. This role is ideal for someone with a strong understanding of airline reservation systems, fare rules, and a customer-first approach. You will play a vital part in delivering smooth and efficient travel experiences. 
 Key Responsibilities Flight Booking & Ticketing: Handle domestic and international flight bookings, issue tickets accurately using airline reservation systems and GDS platforms. Amendments & Cancellations: Process rebookings, date changes, cancellations, and refunds as per airline and company policies. Customer Support: Assist customers with flight-related queries over calls, emails, or chatsincluding fare details, baggage policies, seat selection, and special requests. Fare Calculation & Comparison: Calculate accurate fares, apply discounts, compare flight options, and inform customers of the most economical and convenient choices. GDS & Airline Portal Operations: Work on GDS platforms like Amadeus, Galileo, Sabre or airline-specific portals to issue, modify, or cancel tickets. PNR Management: Monitor and manage PNRs (Passenger Name Records), ensure timely ticketing, and follow up on waitlisted or unconfirmed bookings. Coordination with Airlines & Vendors: Liaise with airlines, consolidators, and backend teams to resolve booking issues, seek fare waivers, or manage special service requests (SSRs). Documentation & Reporting: Maintain booking records, transaction logs, and share MIS reports with supervisors or management as required. Policy Adherence: Follow IATA standards, airline fare rules, and company procedures to ensure accuracy and compliance in all transactions. Team Collaboration: Coordinate with customer care, holiday, and sales teams to ensure smooth delivery of flight services. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience: 0 to 5 years of experience in air ticketing. Freshers with strong GDS training or travel domain knowledge are welcome. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Certification in Travel & Tourism or IATA is preferred. GDS Knowledge: Familiar with at least one Global Distribution System (GDS) like Amadeus, Galileo, or Sabre. Airline Policies: Understanding of airline fare rules, baggage policies, cancellation norms, and reissuance procedures. Communication Skills: Fluent in Hindi and English. Ability to explain travel terms clearly and confidently to customers. Customer Orientation: Polite, professional, and empathetic when handling customer concerns related to flight bookings. Tech Proficiency: Comfortable with reservation systems, airline portals, email communication, and MS Excel for reports. Detail-Oriented: High accuracy in fare calculations, PNR entries, and passenger data input. Problem Solving: Ability to handle last-minute booking challenges, fare differences, and route changes with quick turnaround. Flexibility: Willing to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and during peak travel seasons or emergencies.

Key Skills: Amadeus,GDS,Sabre,Air Ticketing,Galileo,Ticketing,Etihad,CRS

 Industry: Garment Manufacturing & Export

JOB SUMMARY The Trims Sourcing Manager will be responsible for end-to-end sourcing, development, costing, negotiation, vendor management, and timely procurement of garment trims and accessories required for sampling and bulk production. The candidate should have strong knowledge of the trims market, a reliable vendor network, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with Merchandising, Design, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. The role requires strong English communication skills , including professional email communication and regular interaction with suppliers and internal teams. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Trims Sourcing & Development Source and develop all types of garment trims and accessories as per buyer, design and production requirements. Handle sourcing of: Labels and care labels Hangtags Buttons and snaps Zippers Elastics Threads Tapes and cords Interlinings Hooks and other closures Embellishments Packaging materials Polybags, cartons and other packing accessories Develop new trims as per approved samples, specifications and buyer requirements. Coordinate sample development and submit trims for approval within the required timeline. Maintain an updated database/library of available trims and suppliers. B. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop reliable new suppliers. Maintain strong relationships with existing vendors. Develop alternate suppliers for critical and frequently used trims. Evaluate vendors based on quality, price, capacity, lead time, reliability and service . Monitor supplier performance and take corrective action wherever required. Maintain a strong and updated vendor database. C. Costing & Negotiation Obtain quotations from multiple suppliers and prepare comparative statements. Negotiate price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, quality and delivery conditions . Ensure competitive sourcing without compromising quality. Monitor market prices and identify cost-saving opportunities. Develop alternate materials/vendors wherever possible for cost optimization. D. Purchase & Order Management Raise/coordinate Purchase Orders as per approved requirements. Ensure all purchase orders clearly mention specifications, quantity, price, delivery date and approved quality standards. Track order status from placement to final delivery. Ensure trims are available as per the production TNA. Escalate potential delays immediately to management and concerned departments. Coordinate with suppliers for urgent and priority requirements. E. Quality & Compliance Ensure trims meet approved specifications, quality standards and buyer requirements. Coordinate with QA/QC for inspection and approval of trims. Resolve quality issues, shortages, damages and discrepancies with suppliers. Ensure applicable buyer-specific testing and compliance requirements are followed. Maintain proper documentation for approvals, test reports and supplier records. F. Internal Coordination Coordinate closely with: Merchandising Design Sampling Production PPC QA/QC Stores Accounts Understand upcoming production and sampling requirements and plan sourcing accordingly. Ensure smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments. Attend meetings related to sourcing, material planning and production requirements. G. MIS & Documentation Maintain updated records of: Supplier database Quotations Cost sheets Comparative statements Purchase Orders Trim approvals Supplier performance Delivery status Pending materials Cost-saving initiatives Prepare regular Trims Sourcing MIS for management. Track pending and delayed materials and highlight critical issues. H. Team Management Lead and guide the trims sourcing team. Allocate work and monitor daily sourcing activities. Ensure timely completion of sampling, costing, vendor development and procurement activities. Train team members on sourcing procedures, vendor management and documentation. Establish systematic sourcing processes and controls. 3. REQUIRED SKILLS Strong knowledge of garment trims and accessories. Strong vendor network in the trims/accessories market. Excellent vendor development and relationship-management skills. Strong costing and price negotiation skills. Good knowledge of garment manufacturing and production processes. Strong understanding of TNA and material planning. Good knowledge of buyer requirements and quality standards. Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/procurement software . Ability to manage multiple suppliers and urgent requirements. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Excellent English communication skills – mandatory. Should be able to independently draft professional emails to suppliers and internal stakeholders. Good presentation and interpersonal skills. 4. QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE Qualification: 
Graduate / Post Graduate in Textile, Fashion, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration or a related field. Experience: 6–10 years of relevant experience in trims/accessories sourcing, purchase or procurement in the garment/apparel export industry. Experience with international garment buyers/brands will be preferred. Candidates with an established trims supplier network will be preferred. 5. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPA) Timely availability of trims for sampling and bulk production. Effective price negotiation and cost savings. Successful development of reliable vendors. Supplier quality and performance. On-time trim development and approval. On-time delivery as per production TNA. Reduction in material shortages and delays. Development of alternate suppliers. Compliance with buyer specifications and quality requirements. Accurate sourcing MIS and documentation. Effective coordination with Merchandising, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. 6. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Proactive and responsible. Strong ownership of work. Excellent negotiation and communication skills. Good commercial understanding. Detail-oriented and organized. Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Strong relationship-building ability. Solution-oriented approach. Willingness to take ownership of urgent production requirements. Design Blue-Green deployment strategies, traffic shifting, rollback, and regression gates. Design scalable AKS/GKE Kubernetes architectures including namespace isolation, node pools, workload identity, and resource management. 2. Design confidential-computing architecture for secure data processing. Architect private networking using Azure Private Link/Endpoints and GCP VPC Service Controls/Private Service Connect . Design Entra ID / Google Cloud Identity, SSO, Workload Identity Federation and RBAC . Define immutable, tamper-evident audit logging covering agent actions, HITL decisions, evidence retrieval, and output versions. 3. AI System Architecture Architect multi-agent / agentic AI pipelines , workflow orchestration, agent handoffs, HITL gates, and failure handling. Design RAG architectures , including embeddings, vector databases, chunking, indexing, retrieval optimization, and context management. Design deterministic tool architectures separating AI reasoning from data retrieval. Ensure tool access, evidence validation, errors, and data operations are fully auditable. Architect stateless and reproducible agent execution . 4. Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture Design multi-cloud architectures across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Architect persistence using Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage / GCS . Design cloud-native observability using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging . Define secure container supply chains using Sigstore, Binary Authorization, Azure Container Registry and Google Artifact Registry . Establish Kubernetes admission and image-signing controls. 5. Enterprise Integration Architecture Design integrations with ERP, IAM, GRC and workflow platforms across on-premise and cloud environments. Architect GRC integrations using APIs and file-based interfaces . Define data mappings and output formats including JSON, PDF and CSV . Design deployment packages using Helm, Terraform and signed container images . Establish secure, zero-Anaptyss-access deployment processes. 
 Required Experience & Skills Architecture & Cloud 8+ years of enterprise software architecture experience. At least 3 years of AI/ML platform architecture experience. Experience designing production systems in regulated environments , preferably financial services. Strong cloud-native architecture experience with Azure and/or GCP . Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, IAM, encryption, networking and managed cloud services . Experience with BYOC / tenant-isolated deployment models . Architecture-level experience with confidential computing such as Azure Confidential Computing or GCP Confidential VMs. AI / ML Architecture Strong understanding of LLM inference architecture , model serving, API integration, latency optimization, token economics, and production failure handling. Hands-on experience architecting agentic AI / multi-agent systems . Understanding of LLM security risks including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and context manipulation . Security & Compliance Strong knowledge of RSA, JWT, asymmetric cryptography and key management . Experience designing immutable audit logs and tamper-evident audit trails . Familiarity with US banking technology-risk frameworks such as OCC, Federal Reserve SR Letters and FFIEC guidance . Engineering & Documentation Ability to create detailed architecture artefacts including: Component architecture diagrams Data-flow specifications Interface contracts Security boundaries Deployment topologies Experience preparing technical documentation for enterprise architecture, information security, model risk and regulatory review . Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript sufficient to review code and prototype architectural concepts. Good to Have Experience working directly with bank technology risk, information security or enterprise architecture teams . Multi-cloud architecture experience across both Azure and GCP . Confidential computing implementation experience including attestation, enclave programming or sealed storage . Experience designing software licensing and IP protection systems for customer-hosted deployments. Experience with SOC 2 Type II audit preparation . Why Join Us?  Naresh-(.92177-15002.) 
 About the Company BPE Innovations Pvt. Ltd. (Bharat Photon) is a growing Indian manufacturing company engaged in the production of sensor-based washroom automation and hygiene products , including sensor faucets/taps, urinal sensors, flush valves, soap dispensers, hand dryers and related electronic products. We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Purchase / Procurement who can independently manage procurement activities and develop a strong vendor network across Delhi-NCR , particularly for electronic components, electrical items, hardware, sanitary components, packaging materials and other production-related requirements. Job Summary The Assistant Manager – Purchase will be responsible for end-to-end procurement activities , including vendor identification, market sourcing, price negotiation, purchase orders, supplier development, delivery follow-up and coordination with Production, Stores, Quality, Accounts and other departments. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Delhi-NCR markets and vendors , including Chawri Bazar and other major Delhi markets , and should be capable of sourcing materials at competitive prices while maintaining required quality and delivery timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Purchase & Procurement Handle day-to-day procurement activities for electronic, electrical, sensor, sanitary, hardware, packaging and production-related materials . Review purchase requisitions from Production, Stores, R&D, Service and other departments. Identify suitable suppliers and obtain quotations based on material specifications and requirements. Compare quotations, negotiate prices and finalize commercial terms. Prepare and release Purchase Orders as per approved requirements and company policies. Ensure timely procurement of materials to support uninterrupted production. 2. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop new vendors across Delhi-NCR . Maintain a strong network of local suppliers, particularly in Delhi markets such as Chawri Bazar and other relevant industrial/electronic markets . Develop alternative sources for critical and frequently used materials. Negotiate prices, credit terms, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities and other commercial conditions. Maintain long-term professional relationships with reliable suppliers. Monitor vendor performance regarding price, quality, delivery and service . Resolve vendor-related issues and coordinate corrective actions where required. 3. Market Sourcing & Negotiation Conduct regular market visits and supplier interactions to understand current market prices and availability. Maintain updated knowledge of electronic components, electrical items, sensors, cables, connectors, PCB-related materials, hardware, sanitary components and other manufacturing materials . Negotiate aggressively but professionally to achieve cost savings and competitive procurement rates . Verify market rates through multiple suppliers before finalizing major purchases. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and supplier consolidation. 4. Production & Material Coordination Coordinate closely with Production and Stores to understand material requirements and delivery priorities. Ensure critical production materials are available on time. Follow up with suppliers for pending orders and committed delivery dates. Coordinate urgent purchases whenever required to prevent production delays. Work with the Stores team to monitor material consumption, stock levels and replenishment requirements. 5. Purchase Order & Documentation Prepare and maintain accurate Purchase Orders, quotations, comparative statements and vendor records. Maintain proper documentation related to purchases, invoices, delivery challans and supplier communications. Ensure purchase transactions are completed according to approved processes. Maintain vendor databases, price records and historical purchase data. Prepare periodic purchase reports, pending order reports and cost comparison reports for management. 6. Quality & Vendor Performance Coordinate with the Quality and Production teams regarding material quality issues. Ensure suppliers understand required specifications and quality standards. Follow up on rejected, defective or incorrect materials with vendors. Support supplier evaluation and performance review processes. 7. Cost Control & Procurement Planning Monitor procurement spending and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Develop alternate vendors to reduce dependency on a single supplier. Support management in annual/periodic rate negotiations for regular materials. Maintain effective control over purchase costs while ensuring quality and timely delivery. Required Experience 5–10 years of relevant experience in Purchase / Procurement / Supply Chain, preferably in an electronics, electrical, sensor, automation, sanitary or manufacturing company . Strong hands-on experience in local vendor sourcing and market procurement . Candidates with an established Delhi-NCR supplier/vendor network will be preferred. Strong knowledge of Delhi markets, including Chawri Bazar and other relevant electronic/electrical markets , will be an advantage. Experience in handling production-related procurement and urgent material requirements. Proven experience in price negotiation, vendor development and supplier management . Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in BBA, B.Com, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field . MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain or Procurement will be an added advantage. Required Skills Strong vendor sourcing and development skills. Excellent negotiation and cost-control skills. Good knowledge of electronic and electrical components and manufacturing materials. Strong knowledge of Delhi-NCR supplier markets . Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good analytical and decision-making abilities. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and ERP/Purchase software . Ability to prepare quotation comparisons and purchase analysis. Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent procurement requirements. Strong understanding of Purchase Orders, quotations, vendor negotiations and procurement documentation. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be: A hands-on procurement professional , not only an administrative purchaser. Well connected with Delhi-NCR vendors and local markets . Comfortable visiting markets and suppliers whenever required. Strong in price negotiation and vendor development . Capable of independently handling purchase requirements from requirement generation to material delivery . Experienced in supporting manufacturing/production operations. Proactive, responsible and result-oriented. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely availability of materials for production. Purchase cost savings and effective negotiation. Development of new and alternate vendors. Vendor delivery performance. Material quality and rejection control. Reduction in urgent/emergency purchases. Purchase order accuracy and timely closure. Supplier relationship and service quality. Salary & Benefits Salary: 50,000 – 60,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability. Other benefits will be provided as per company policy. Position Manager/Senior Manager Department MIS and Business Intelligence Location Noida, UP 
 Job Summary Company is looking for an experienced MIS professional to lead the transition of the MIS function from routine, transaction-level report generation to a strategic Management Information & Business Intelligence function. The incumbent will design and own dashboards, KPI scorecards, and decision-support reporting that give Directors and senior leadership real-time, actionable visibility into the business enabling faster and better-informed business calls across sales, production, quality, supply chain, and finance. 

 Company Overview A fast-growing, Made-in-India company shaping the future of the LED lighting and electrical solutions industry. With over a decade of industry experience, Its offers 1000+ product categories across residential, commercial, and industrial applications, supported by a state-of-the-art 2,00,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Noida and a strong network of 12,000+ retailers across India. Our portfolio extends beyond lighting to include wires & cables, modular switches, switchgears, water heaters, and electrical accessories, enabling us to provide a complete electrical ecosystem to our customers. At Company, innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Our in-house R&D capabilities and NABL-accredited laboratory ensure that our products are rigorously tested and developed in line with leading industry standards, including BIS, ISO, and RoHS. Our strong industry presence is reflected in approvals from 10 Maharatna and 9 Navratna organizations, along with partnerships with leading organizations such as ONGC, HPCL, NTPC, Indian Oil, Huawei, Tata Projects, and OYO. 
 Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end evolution of the MIS function from “data reporting” to “management information” — shifting the team’s output from static reports to insight-driven decision support. Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI / Excel / equivalent) that consolidate data from ERP, production, quality, sales, and supply-chain systems into a single, reliable view. Partner directly with Directors and functional heads to understand the business questions behind each request, and translate them into the right metrics, cuts, and visualizations. Develop and maintain KPI scorecards across Sales, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and HR, aligned with the organization’s KRA/KPI and incentive frameworks. Drive trend and variance analysis — sales vs. forecast, OEE and rejection trends, inventory ageing, SKU classification (Runner / Repeater / Stranger), and working-capital indicators — and proactively flag risks and opportunities to leadership. Automate recurring MIS reports and eliminate manual, Excel-heavy compilation; standardize data definitions, formats, and refresh cycles across departments. Establish data-governance practices — a single source of truth, data validation checks, and clear ownership — so leadership can trust every number in the dashboard. Prepare and present monthly/quarterly business review packs to Directors and senior leadership, with clear narrative, insight, and recommended actions — not just data. Evaluate and recommend upgrades to BI tools, reporting infrastructure, and automation (e.g., Power BI, Power Query, ERP reporting modules) as the business scales. Act as a cross-functional bridge — working closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Finance, and HR to source data and understand the operational context behind it. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Commerce, or a related field; MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred. 8–12 years of progressive experience in MIS, Business Analytics, or Business Intelligence roles, including at least 2–3 years managing a team or reporting function. Manufacturing, FMEG, or electrical/electronics industry background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, macros) and hands-on expertise with Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI/visualization tool. Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts; exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) for data extraction and reporting. Demonstrated experience building dashboards and scorecards used directly by senior leadership for decision-making.

 Come Join Our Software Integration Team!! Our main activity consists in setting up GE Vernova software in different environments for internal and external customers, supporting project activities and providing expertise in tailoring the components based on requirements. We have a hybrid work environment as we work from home, the office and travel to customer sites as needed.  GE Vernova allows us to bring a significant contribution to the Worldwide Electrical Energy context. Delivering on life\-critical solutions we are deeply immersed into the worlds of Transmission, Distribution, Asset Management and Market Management making sure we shape how the energy landscape looks today and tomorrow.

* Distribution Management Systems (DMS)

description:
Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .

 B.E. / B.Tech. in Engineering ; M.Tech. or MBA preferred. 
 15+ Years of exp in Metal Sourcing ( Global Sourcing)
 Proven track record of managing end-to-end operations, P&L, and business performance .

Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation.

title: Consultant Neurologist
description:
Role & responsibilities Evaluate patients through detailed history-taking and neurological examination. Diagnose and manage common neurological conditions under appropriate clinical guidance. Review and interpret relevant investigations including MRI, CT, EEG, EMG/NCS, and laboratory reports. Develop and implement appropriate treatment plans based on clinical findings and investigations. Manage patients with conditions such as stroke, epilepsy, headache, seizures, movement disorders, neuropathies, and other neurological disorders. Provide timely consultation for OPD, IPD, Emergency, and referred patients. Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans as clinically indicated. Recognize and manage neurological emergencies with timely escalation to senior consultants when required. Counsel patients and their attendants regarding diagnosis, treatment options, prognosis, and follow-up care. Maintain accurate and complete patient medical records and clinical documentation. Coordinate with Neurosurgery, Internal Medicine, Critical Care, Radiology, Emergency Medicine, and other specialties as required. Participate in clinical rounds, case discussions, and multidisciplinary meetings. Assist in the management of critically ill neurological patients in coordination with the ICU team. Follow hospital clinical protocols, infection-control practices, and patient-safety standards. Participate in clinical audits, quality initiatives, academic activities, and continuing medical education programs. Maintain professional ethics, patient confidentiality, and high standards of patient care. 
 Preferred candidate profile Strong clinical assessment and neurological examination skills. Good knowledge of neurological disorders and their management. Ability to interpret MRI and CT brain/spine findings with clinical correlation. Basic understanding of EEG and EMG/NCS reports. Good communication and patient counselling skills. Ability to identify and respond appropriately to neurological emergencies. Strong clinical decision-making and problem-solving abilities. Effective coordination with multidisciplinary teams. Good documentation and medical record-keeping skills. Patient-centric approach with professional and ethical conduct. Willingness to work in rotational duties, emergency calls, and on-call responsibilities as per hospital requirements. DNB / DrNB / DM in Neurology ONLY Fresher to 2 years of experience
